Experience.title: Experience
Experience.description: 15+ years in software engineering: enterprise ERP frontend leadership, a government software division, and open-source i18n tooling.

freelance.description: Open-source i18n tooling and SharePoint document management for a law-office system.
highlights: Built and published @tuhama/translation-manager, an open-source npm package with an i18n management UI, AI-assisted translation, and code-context extraction.

Contributed to a case management system for a Qatari law firm, now in production testing: built its SharePoint document management in React with @azure/msal-react and the Microsoft Graph API (Microsoft Entra ID sign-in), plus the filterable, resizable data tables.

bpro.description: Led frontend development of an enterprise ERP aimed at large companies in the Gulf region: a 150,000-line React and TypeScript codebase, held alongside the government role.
highlights: Frontend lead and architect for 4+ years: designed the architecture, wrote the coding guidelines and lint rules, reviewed and approved every pull request, and mentored four junior developers, two at a time.
Designed the shared page templates and component library that more than half of the 1,300+ module files build on, across 12 ERP modules including Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Finance, and HR.
Built the granular role-based access control (RBAC) system, from permission management screens to permission-filtered routes and navigation.
Designed and built a custom PDF report engine on jsPDF, with page bands, data fields, an expression evaluator, and drawing for rich text, images, and barcodes.
Kept large reports responsive with pagination and list virtualization, cut initial load with lazy loading and dynamic imports, and tracked down unnecessary re-renders with React DevTools.
Integrated frontend workflows into Jenkins CI/CD with Gitee, working with backend and DevOps teams on automated branch deployments.

directorate.role: Head of Analysis and Software Division, IT Department
directorate.description: Headed the software division of a regional finance directorate, covering systems analysis, staff training on national tax systems, and internal software prototypes.
highlights: Led a division of up to four engineers in systems analysis and internal software development.
Trained finance staff on nationwide tax systems procured from software vendors and used across Syria, where processing errors carry legal liability.

Designed and built two internal prototypes: a Personnel Portal in Java EE (servlets, JSP, JPA) on MySQL, and a Warehouse Management System with a Spring Boot REST API secured by JWT and a React and Ant Design frontend.

miditec.description: Trained and worked as a Java programmer on MTZ Web, MIDITEC’s ERP product, directly after graduation.
highlights: Worked on MTZ Web, MIDITEC’s ERP product, immediately after graduation.
